title: To Whom Do Language Models Align? Measuring Principal Hierarchies Under High-Stakes Competing Demands

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model compliance rates in high-stakes legal and medical scenarios where a standard user requests an action that violates verifiable professional standards, such as citing overruled case law or recommending withdrawn drugs.

Measuring how often models comply with incorrect or harmful requests when they are explicitly endorsed by an authority figure (e.g., a senior legal associate or a medical doctor), and comparing these rates to baseline user deference.
